decisions.reason: The same source message already introduces Ridgehaven's separate customer database; the analytics-specific modification adds no further customer-database state change.
The same source message already introduces Ridgehaven's separate gift-card operations; the analytics-specific modification does not alter that requirement.
The same source message already establishes separate Ridgehaven memberships, and the analytics isolation change adds no membership update.
Calendar isolation was already established for all locations, and message 55 does not change calendar behavior or placement.
Separating Ridgehaven analytics does not change Harbor Valley's required availability or its linkage from the master site.
A same-message MODIFY already records Ridgehaven booking isolation and delayed booking activation; the analytics-specific change requires no additional booking update.
Separate payouts were already active through separate Wix and payment setups; message 55 reiterates that arrangement without changing its state.
The same source message already introduces independently controlled Ridgehaven staff access, and the analytics modification adds no staff-access change.
Ridgehaven analytics isolation does not change the requirements for preserving Harbor Valley SEO during migration.
The existing state already requires each location, including Ridgehaven, to use its own payment processing setup; message 55 does not materially change that state.
A same-message MODIFY already records use of the Ridgehaven page as the future-location template; Ridgehaven analytics isolation does not necessarily extend that backend rule to future locations.
The analytics isolation decision does not alter which Harbor Valley content or images are reused for the new website.
